records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total revenue decreased by $10.7 million, or 11.4%, to $83.7 million from $94.4 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have existing relationships with all major OEMs or their tier 1 suppliers, and while our customer contracts vary, they generally represent multi-year engagements, giving us some level of visibility into future revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As of December 31, 2022, our net working capital, excluding deferred revenue and deferred costs, was $145.0 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating margin decreased 26.7 percentage points to negative 2.4% from 24.3%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash used in operating activities was $2.1 million, a net change of $7.2 million from cash provided by operating activities of $5.1 million.
